text:
The sweetest tradition at Haunted Mansion Holiday 🍪✨ #Disneyland
Step behind the scenes of a beloved Disneyland tradition! 🎃🍪 See how Disneyland cast members design, bake, and install the iconic gingerbread house created for Haunted Mansion Holiday's 25th anniversary. From concept art to the finished display in the Grand Ballroom, discover the craftsmanship and creativity that bring this spooky-sweet masterpiece to life.

Welcome, foolish mortals, to Behind the Screams, a series offering an exclusive look at the creation of Haunted Mansion Holiday located at Disneyland Park.

Jack Skellington has been busy decorating the Haunted Mansion for the Haunted Mansion Holiday—with frightfully festive touches inspired by Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas. Celebrating 25 years of showstopping confectionary creations, the attraction’s annual gingerbread house sits inside the ballroom scene, taking the form of a delightfully monstrous music box.

As a holiday ride overlay at Disneyland Park, Haunted Mansion Holiday adds a seasonal spin on the Haunted Mansion attraction.
Experience thrilling sights and seasonal surprises created by the residents of Halloween Town. Sally, Oogie Boogie and other Nightmare characters from the beloved film will be on hand to wish you "Season’s Screamings!"
